basic_details.job_title: RRC Central Railway Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Theatre Actor, Harmonium Player Posts
basic_details.short_information: Railway Recruitment Cell, Central Railway (रेल भर्ती सेल, मध्य रेल), under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, is filling two Level-2 posts under the Cultural Quota for 2026-27: one Theatre Actor (Male) (थिएटर अभिनेता (पुरुष)) and one Harmonium Player (हारमोनियम वादक). Candidates need 12th (+2), or Matriculation with ITI or Act Apprenticeship, plus a degree, diploma or certificate in the relevant art. Applications are made online on www.rrccr.com from 5 November 2026 (10.00 hrs) to 4 December 2026 (18.00 hrs).

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through the payment gateway integrated with the online application, by debit card, credit card or internet banking; bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate. Ineligible candidates who still apply will not get a refund, and the fee is not refunded if the vacancies are cancelled. Minority candidates (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist and Zoroastrian (Parsi)) claiming exemption or refund must give the self-declaration in Annexure 'A' and an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper at document verification. Economically Backward Class candidates (annual family income below Rs. 50,000) must produce an income certificate in the prescribed proforma from an authorised authority (District Magistrate or revenue officer up to Tahsildar, sitting MPs, Union Ministers, or a BPL card/IZZAT MST certificate) at document verification.

how_to_apply: Go to www.rrccr.com and follow the detailed guidelines given there for the online application.

Log on and fill in personal details/bio-data carefully, including the 12-digit Aadhaar number or the 28-digit Aadhaar enrolment ID (applicants from Jammu and Kashmir, Meghalaya and Assam may enter voter ID, passport, driving licence or another valid Government ID number).
Give an active mobile number and email ID; all RRC messages will be sent by email/SMS.

Upload a colour passport-size photograph (3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–70 KB, not older than three months, without cap or sunglasses) and a running-hand signature (3.5 cm x 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–30 KB), not in block/capital or disjoint letters.
Upload the documents listed below and enter the details of your desirable qualifications.
Pay the fee through the payment gateway; no change or edit is allowed after payment. Save or print the e-receipt.
Note the registration account ID and take a printout of the application, which must be produced at document verification and practical demonstration. Nothing is to be sent to RRC by post.
Marksheet/certificate of the minimum educational qualification (para 2(a)).
Date of birth proof: Class 10 certificate or marksheet, or school leaving certificate showing the date of birth.
Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, where applicable – SC/ST in the Annexure 'C' format; OBC Non-Creamy Layer in the Central Government format (Annexure 'D'), issued on or after 01/04/2026.
The institution recognition certificate described under professional qualification.
For any problem in submitting or printing the online application, candidates can email the help desk at [email protected].
important_instructions: At the exam hall, bring the e-call letter, Aadhaar card or a valid photo ID, one colour passport-size photograph and original SC/ST/OBC certificate where applicable; without a valid photo ID entry is refused. On the practical demonstration day, bring originals of age, qualification, caste and cultural discipline documents, self-attested photocopies, your own cultural kit and four passport-size photographs; certificates in other languages need a certified English/Hindi translation. Candidates may need to stay 2–3 days for the practical demonstration at their own arrangement; no TA/DA or accommodation is given. Candidates already working in PSUs/Government organisations must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the practical demonstration. SC/ST candidates who upload a valid caste certificate (Annexure 'C') can get a free second-class railway pass for the written exam and must carry the original certificate and ID while travelling. Candidates debarred for life by any RRB/RRC, or for a period not yet over, need not apply; multiple applications with different details will be rejected. Mobile phones, calculators, Bluetooth devices and other communication devices are not allowed at the exam venue. Appointment is subject to medical fitness, final verification of educational and caste certificates and verification of antecedents/character. Legal matters fall under the jurisdiction of CAT, Mumbai only.

content_sections.heading: RRC CR Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the pay amount in rupees; it only describes the posts as Level-2.

Employment Notice No. आरआरसी/सीआर/ सांस्कृतिक/03/2026 (RRC/CR/Cultural/03/2026) dated 05/11/2026
18 to 30 years (for Unreserved) as on 01/01/2027; SC/ST 5 years and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years extra

content_sections.heading: About RRC CR
content_sections.text: The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC) of Central Railway works under the Ministry of Railways and has its office at CPM Conversion Office Building, P D Mello Road, Wadibunder, Mumbai – 400 010. This notice is its Cultural Quota recruitment for 2026-27. RRC only recommends the names of successful candidates; the appointment process is handled by the Principal Chief Personnel Officer of Central Railway.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers 2 posts at Level-2 in two cultural disciplines. The posts are open to all; there is no reservation for any caste. If no suitable candidate is available for one of the two disciplines, a suitable candidate of the other discipline will be selected instead, irrespective of gender. The number of vacancies is tentative and may be reduced or even become nil according to the actual needs of the railway administration.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, the East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam to settle permanently in India. Candidates other than Indian citizens need a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India; they may be admitted to the exam provisionally but must produce it at document verification. 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent from a recognised board with at least 50% aggregate marks. The 50% condition does not apply to SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD candidates or to candidates with a qualification higher than 12th; OR Matriculation from a recognised board and Course Completed Act Apprenticeship; OR Matriculation from a recognised board and ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT. Persons appointed as Clerk-cum-Typist must pass a typing test at 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi within two years of appointment; their appointment stays temporary until then. Candidates must also upload a certificate from the institution confirming that it is recognised by the Central or State Government, or run by a Government body set up under an Act of Parliament or a State Legislature. A candidate who cannot upload it will be treated as provisionally eligible and allowed to sit the written exam, but must submit it on the day of document verification, failing which the candidature will be cancelled. Candidates without the professional qualification need not apply. Preference to candidates proficient in script writing and direction. Three years' experience in Acting/Script Writing/Direction; preference to experience with Doordarshan/All India Radio/a reputed or national television channel/a reputed theatre group (documentary proof required). Certificate of an individual award in Acting/Script Writing/Direction at state/national level competitions. Certificates of participation in state/national/international theatre festivals. Knowledge of light designing/light operating/set designing gives an additional advantage. Three years' experience of playing harmonium with Doordarshan/All India Radio/a reputed television musical group or channel (documentary proof required). An individual award or certificate for harmonium playing at state or national level competitions/programmes. Experience or mastery in playing 'Lehra' or accompanying classical/instrumental solo performances gives an additional advantage. Proficiency in playing Hindi songs (film/semi-classical) on keyboard, with a certificate from a reputed music group. A "reputed" theatre or musical group means one that has performed on various stages with national-level artists, or includes artists who have worked in All India Radio, television or the film industry. The railway reserves the right to reject any application. In the onli

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts are at Level-2. On initial appointment, pay will be the minimum of the pay level, with other allowances as admissible at that time. Where training is prescribed for the post, selected candidates must undergo it and only a stipend, as applicable, is paid during training. Wherever required, candidates must pay a security deposit and execute an indemnity bond. Selected candidates may be posted anywhere on Central Railway, and male candidates finally appointed are liable for active service in the Railway Engineers unit of the Territorial Army.

content_sections.text: The fee is paid through the payment gateway integrated with the online application, by debit card, credit card or internet banking; bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection consists of a Written Examination/CBT/Tab Mode, then Document Verification, then a Practical Demonstration. There will be no interview. Only candidates who pass the written exam are called for document verification and the practical demonstration. Negative marking: 1/3 of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. A minimum of 40% marks in the written exam is needed to qualify for the practical demonstration. RRC may, at its discretion, hold the written exam for all or a limited number of candidates. The date, time and venue of the written exam, practical demonstration and document verification will be fixed by RRC and told to eligible candidates in due course; requests for postponement will not be accepted. Eligibility status will be shown on the RRC website, and the e-call letter will be available there about seven days before the written exam; no admit card is sent by post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RRC CR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Level-2 posts under the Cultural Quota 2026-27: one Theatre Actor (Male) and one Harmonium Player.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RRC CR Cultural Quota 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 4 December 2026 at 18.00 hrs; it opened on 5 November 2026 at 10.00 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for RRC CR Cultural Quota posts?
faq.answer: 12th (+2) with 50% marks, or Matriculation with Act Apprenticeship or NCVT/SCVT ITI, plus a degree/diploma/certificate in Acting/Drama Arts (Theatre Actor) or in Harmonium (Harmonium Player) from a Government-recognised institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RRC CR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 30 years (for Unreserved) as on 01/01/2027, with 5 years extra for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer).

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: Both posts are at Level-2, with the minimum of the pay level and admissible allowances at initial appointment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500, of which Rs. 400 is refunded after bank charges to eligible candidates who appear in the written exam; SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD/Women/Economically Backward Class candidates pay Rs. 250, refunded after bank charges on appearing.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for RRC CR Cultural Quota 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on www.rrccr.com, upload the photograph, signature and certificates, and pay the fee through the payment gateway; no printout is to be sent by post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A 50-mark written exam/CBT/Tab mode (50 questions, 60 minutes, 1/3 negative marking, 40% to qualify), then document verification, then a 35-mark practical demonstration and 15 marks for testimonials, certificates and awards.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an interview in RRC CR Cultural Quota recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that there will be no interview.

faq.question: Q10. Are any posts reserved for a caste category?
faq.answer: No, both posts are open to all and there is no reservation for any caste, though age relaxation and fee concessions apply as listed.
